name: vast-3090
description: The aborted 1x RTX 3090 Vast.ai campaign; kept as a runnable plan with the bandwidth trap encoded.

estimate.basis: 2026-10-25 instance 57724534 was auto-stopped after 14 min and cost $3.983, almost all download

caveats: NO MEASUREMENTS: the 2026-10-25 3090 run was aborted when the Vast credit ran out; no server ever started and no cell exists.
That host billed $0.052/GB = $53.33/TB; 73 GB cost $3.80. The offer filter here caps internet_down_cost_per_tb at $5/TB.
The cheapest 3090 offers were on driver 570.181, below the cuda12 floor (575.51) as well as the cuda13 floor (580.65); they are unusable for Strata.
Top up the account and check can_pay=true before renting; the 2x and 4x configs were never rented for that reason.
The intended cells were 1k/4k/16k/64k x C1/2/4; 131k and 262k were to be skipped everywhere.
